questions.explanation: **(a).** Copper forms basic copper carbonate CuCO3·Cu(OH)2 (green); silver forms silver sulphide Ag2S (black).

questions.explanation: **(c) displacement.** Aluminium, being more reactive, displaces iron from its oxide. It is also a redox and a highly exothermic (thermite) reaction.

questions.stem: अस्मिन् पद्ये कस्याः महिमा वर्णिता?
